# ASB Training Hub

ASB Training Hub is a career training institute in Trivandrum, Kerala offering job-oriented ERP/SAP-style, programming, AI, management, and internship courses with practical training and placement support.

## Site

- Website: https://www.asbtraininghub.com/
- Sitemap: https://www.asbtraininghub.com/sitemap.xml
- Contact: https://www.asbtraininghub.com/contact
- Apply: https://www.asbtraininghub.com/apply
- Email: info@asbtraininghub.com
- Phone/WhatsApp: +91 87147 73304

## Course Areas

- ERP and SAP-style modules: finance and controlling, materials management, sales and distribution, production planning, plant maintenance, quality management, project systems, HCM, SCM, CRM, SRM, cloud HR, and ABAP.
- Programming: Python full stack, Java, JavaScript, C, C++, HTML, CSS, PHP, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift, and Dart.
- AI: artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, data science with AI, NLP, robotics AI, agentic AI, and full stack AI.
- Management: logistics, supply chain, warehouse management, hospitality, finance, HR, and IT management.
- Internships: ERP, accounting, HR, Python full stack, AI, ML, GenAI, data science AI, agentic AI, and full stack AI internship programs.
